why: The fix round (0177) for slice 1 of docs/plan/quests/law-options-0580-PLAN.md, next/ and tooling, after the review sent it back. (0) origin/main merged in (merge commit), two conflicts resolved keeping both sides: .github/ci/workflow-lint/check-job.ts's header comment now names the plant check (0580) and the copy-paste advice step (0587), and next/packages/vitest/src/index.ts exports both Plants (0580) and Stub (0554). (1) The members' meta law in next/packages/vitest/src/Law.test.ts now registers one case per member and input kind: it.prop on fast-check inputs too, it.effect.prop on Effect inputs too, and it.live.prop on both, so the two planted breaks the review found escaping (options dropped in effectLaw's Effect-input branch and in it.prop's fast-check branch of next/packages/vitest/src/Law.ts) now turn it red. (2) The four laws the review found with no recorded plant on the real code now have one each, run on the real Law.ts or internal/fastCheck.ts (copy, plant, run, restore, cmp). (3) The review's finding is half fixed here: .agents/skills/tests/scripts/plant.ts types its vitest options as vitest's CliOptions (the as const tuple gave TS2769, and dropping as const alone widened config to boolean), so it compiles. It is not added to .agents/tsconfig.json: it imports the root vitest.config.ts, and the files that reaches outside .agents/ fail that program on duplicate @demlik/tea warnings, which tsconfig.base.json allows only under .agents/** and oxlint-plugins/duplicate-packages.test.ts (E3) pins there, so adding it would loosen a law. That rest is field/findings/2026-11-16-plant-ts-type-error.json. (4) Two lint failures the merge brought in, fixed here: main's pnpm lint:kind (0584, test-kind.ts) refused next/packages/vitest/src/Law.integration.test.ts as an .integration. file that reaches no real thing; its nested vitest runs in-process on a worker thread and starts no process, port or temp folder, as the plain .github/ci/shard-rows.test.ts and related.test.ts do, so it is renamed with git mv to Law.runner.test.ts and now runs on every pull request; no law in it changed. And main's anti-slop rules, now on in next/packages/vitest, refused three things: two literal _tag objects in Law.test.ts (no-manual-tagged-construction), where the toTestOptions law's expected label and the members' meta law's helper now make the Label with its own case's make, the generator unchanged and each claim unchanged; and a five-deep ternary in Law.ts's labelIn (max-ternary-depth), a product line, rewritten as one if per label with the same answers, which the fix round may do (0177) and every law in the package still passes.

Each record names the law the review named and the verdict of the real run: plants 1 to 3 turned red exactly the cases on the planted path (it.effect.prop and it.live.prop on Effect inputs; it.prop on fast-check inputs; it.effect.prop and it.live.prop on fast-check inputs), plant 4 turned every 'a run of N cases' case red, plant 5 turned the counterexample law red with 'threshold 0: expected pass to be fail' (and the seed law beside it), and plant 6 was red in the package typecheck (tsc --noEmit -p next/packages/vitest) with TS2554 at Law.types.test.ts lines 21 to 23, the two-label not cases.
